Platforms.heading: AIM captures these enterprise marketing assets and turns them into reusable growth capabilities

PainPoints.heading: Companies do not need another writing box
PainPoints.subheading: They need their existing marketing assets organized, structured, and made useful to AI.
PainPoints.pain1Desc: Company docs, product manuals, project reviews, and sales Q&A live in separate files and chats.
PainPoints.pain2Title: Founder Expertise Is Hard to Copy
PainPoints.pain2Desc: The sharpest judgment and sales language sits in the founder's head, not in the team's workflow.
PainPoints.pain2StatLabel: From personal skill to company asset
PainPoints.pain3Desc: Strong product advantages often read like jargon, so customers do not feel the value.
PainPoints.pain4Desc: Repeated concerns are not converted into standard answers for content, sales, and support.

HowItWorks.heading: AIM's training loop from assets to agent
HowItWorks.subheading: It does not ask AI to improvise. It turns enterprise marketing assets into a searchable, composable knowledge system.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Bring in business materials, founder expertise, project cases, selling points, and customer Q&A.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Extract tags, scenarios, pain points, proof, scripts, and conversion goals.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: AIM learns the business, voice, customer concerns, and sales logic.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Produce topics, spoken scripts, case content, value language, and sales answers.
HowItWorks.step5Desc: Quality checks and human edits feed effective language back into the asset library.

Differentiators.heading: Why it is not a normal AI writing tool
Differentiators.subheading: Writing tools generate text. AIM helps company marketing assets keep growing.
Differentiators.diff0Desc: Build the core IP profile once. Every topic, script, and answer reuses it automatically — then hide it so it never gets in your way.
Differentiators.diff1Desc: Materials, expertise, cases, selling points, and Q&A are structured before AI writes.
Differentiators.diff2Desc: Output is based on real cases and real customer questions, not generic templates.
Differentiators.diff3Desc: Useful scripts, answers, and value language are saved back into the knowledge base.
Differentiators.diff4Desc: Content is designed around trust, pain, proof, objections, and action.
Differentiators.diff5Desc: Founder judgment, tone, and language become a capability the team can call.
Differentiators.diff6Desc: Every script can be checked across editing quality, AI taste, hook strength, and logic.
